messages:
maria: Quick sync Were doing the marketplace onboarding runbook for AWS/GCP/Azure. Two Azure-specific items popped up: certificate chain for offer assets and reseller pricing SKU mapping. Anyone from infra/legal free to chime in?

alex: I'm on SKU mapping. Proposal: a single canonical sku_id per plan, then per-cloud alias mappings. Example: canonical=redwood-inference-standard-v1 ; azure_alias=redwood-inf-az-st-v1. Keeps analytics consistent.

gokul: For Azure certs we need a PEM chain and the publisher profile's contact email. Also, Azure requires a support URL on the offer. We should reuse https://support.redwood.ai/marketplace.

jordan: For reseller pricing, legal needs to know margin passthrough rules and whether we allow third-party resellers to set seat multipliers. My preference: no seat multipliers without prior approval. I'll draft a clause.

sam: Packaging manifest heads-up: we must include a `media_type` field so marketplace UI knows if it's AMI/container/marketplace-saas. Example snippet: {"sku_id":"redwood-inf-payg-v1","media_type":"container","billing_dimensions":["tokens"],"compatibility":["hosted","dedicated"]}

alex: Nice. Also include `public_changelog_url` so listing shows release notes.

gokul: IAM notes for AWS and GCP: publisher account ID required, plus a read-only IAM role we attach for marketplace verification. I'll share the CloudFormation / Terraform snippet after lunch.

maria: Action list: alex finalize canonical sku -> cloud alias map by tomorrow noon. gokul provide cert requirements + infra snippet by EOD. jordan provide reseller clause draft in drive. sam create a manifest template and add README. I'll collect all assets and do a final metadata pass.

marketplace-bot: Heads up: Azure offer validation typically takes 2-3 business days after submission. Ensure all assets have alt text and logos are 1:1 square PNG under 2MB.

jordan: Uploaded clause draft: https://drive.redwood/reseller-clause-draft. Please add comments by EOD.

alex: Putting SKU alias CSV here: https://docs.redwood/marketplace-skus.csv (will update with pricing bands).

sam: I've added the manifest template to the repo: /marketplace/manifests/template.json. It has fields: sku_id, billing_dimensions, pricing, media_type, compatibility, public_changelog_url.

gokul: I'll run a quick validation that the AMI/container digests match the manifest URIs. If mismatch, we'll bump manifest version.

maria: Great. If we don't hit blockers, aim to submit AWS/GCP this week and Azure early next week. Thanks all :rocket:

marketplace-bot: Reminder: required listing fields include legal_contact, technical_contact, pricing_table, and telemetry_contact.
